` [Highlight start] It is generally best to avoid alcohol while taking antibiotics [Highlight end] ` , though the exact risk depends on the specific medication. Moderate drinking does not stop most common antibiotics from working, but it can worsen side effects, cause dehydration, and slow your recovery from an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXu9qylKg8L4mcf9vLYA_B62Fov9gLbJyoENDxYG7aAQD8kMj6J_N99u2jUEc8hE--mZ0E94Z7tYyvXi1U3TKVxZmeghzN2QNv-J4YEtanfUiJs8oai42UV7oWh28B8XsM1W6rdUyX4Yk71hy6nkEy)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXHFaH7U3latcB5jaDBvgxTnU5xTzy_1b55W9UUV9Y6ht7nyvIh4H3cZsHLEI0M6SEs_SjUFwL0Vi03audGm4e10z3NaVnL-KO1OavHzfMpMdp7n0JkE8pPxoYxN-BLsftPFC-ke9wMoUVT9MjMfhJiA)

### High-Risk Antibiotics to Avoid with Alcohol

- **Metronidazole (Flagyl) and Tinidazole (Tindamax):** Mixing these with any amount of alcohol can trigger a severe reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting, headache, and fast heart rate). Avoid alcohol during treatment and for up to **72 hours** after the last dose.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXHFaH7U3latcB5jaDBvgxTnU5xTzy_1b55W9UUV9Y6ht7nyvIh4H3cZsHLEI0M6SEs_SjUFwL0Vi03audGm4e10z3NaVnL-KO1OavHzfMpMdp7n0JkE8pPxoYxN-BLsftPFC-ke9wMoUVT9MjMfhJiA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXwgltIP0SsXvK8QiuLlR5jbuvME5DWXh_Dy5MD1To0DT-tdf0jfv-cELzqYMbWFrfLXML2b4OIN2GHVa4vLzrtv50_PSu30Rea_RvDCkpSvkLI_9zlbiaij5JQLDQFPobBXmKZXvXLfeTKDCe2-3W_5byEead4DW3)
- **Linezolid (Zyvox):** Tyramine-rich drinks—such as tap or home-brewed beer, red wine, and vermouth—can cause a dangerous spike in blood pressure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXHFaH7U3latcB5jaDBvgxTnU5xTzy_1b55W9UUV9Y6ht7nyvIh4H3cZsHLEI0M6SEs_SjUFwL0Vi03audGm4e10z3NaVnL-KO1OavHzfMpMdp7n0JkE8pPxoYxN-BLsftPFC-ke9wMoUVT9MjMfhJiA)
- **Cefotetan and certain cephalosporins:** May cause a disulfiram-like reaction with symptoms like flushing, nausea, and vomiting.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXwgltIP0SsXvK8QiuLlR5jbuvME5DWXh_Dy5MD1To0DT-tdf0jfv-cELzqYMbWFrfLXML2b4OIN2GHVa4vLzrtv50_PSu30Rea_RvDCkpSvkLI_9zlbiaij5JQLDQFPobBXmKZXvXLfeTKDCe2-3W_5byEead4DW3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXHFaH7U3latcB5jaDBvgxTnU5xTzy_1b55W9UUV9Y6ht7nyvIh4H3cZsHLEI0M6SEs_SjUFwL0Vi03audGm4e10z3NaVnL-KO1OavHzfMpMdp7n0JkE8pPxoYxN-BLsftPFC-ke9wMoUVT9MjMfhJiA)
- **Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (Bactrim, Septra):** Can cause uncomfortable reactions or flushing; check with a doctor or pharmacist before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXANLtXUBBq8ZyFFdsOSADBjAmhshjeITeSNNkXRpHL0PZUup5jD-honq91U9CMxRFlEdMziG2lrlIi7vnReLarOxkCxXbZmRG1AYsd7pXfHjeTIPJlW1mo9X_R8i6JvNRoq1DjfRy6w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1_meq0A31qIbC_JIDbcTyXO7PMA5lbMJxjgaMu07iA8g84cCSusnBN8p8VavCtt-Y6MHg9bGhCXe_BQOGJ3c6UrlwZKDKoQ5XPCwWux2nzGUbTWMinLQWKFZbLacnKzOi8dElrEfGOoybkc5XRysrqRlYhJ-M9WR39sWwz8t0RLUFVSZJBwppug8OdlzSoBwuwCq)

### General Effects When Recovering

- **Amplified side effects:** Both alcohol and antibiotics can cause stomach upset, nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, and drowsiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXu9qylKg8L4mcf9vLYA_B62Fov9gLbJyoENDxYG7aAQD8kMj6J_N99u2jUEc8hE--mZ0E94Z7tYyvXi1U3TKVxZmeghzN2QNv-J4YEtanfUiJs8oai42UV7oWh28B8XsM1W6rdUyX4Yk71hy6nkEy)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXwgltIP0SsXvK8QiuLlR5jbuvME5DWXh_Dy5MD1To0DT-tdf0jfv-cELzqYMbWFrfLXML2b4OIN2GHVa4vLzrtv50_PSu30Rea_RvDCkpSvkLI_9zlbiaij5JQLDQFPobBXmKZXvXLfeTKDCe2-3W_5byEead4DW3)
- **Slower healing:** Alcohol disrupts sleep, lowers energy, and dehydrates you while your body is fighting off an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXHFaH7U3latcB5jaDBvgxTnU5xTzy_1b55W9UUV9Y6ht7nyvIh4H3cZsHLEI0M6SEs_SjUFwL0Vi03audGm4e10z3NaVnL-KO1OavHzfMpMdp7n0JkE8pPxoYxN-BLsftPFC-ke9wMoUVT9MjMfhJiA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX3uwXRDDRqpObOEQTf-9-sdOTyShvkG5b6D_BE4vmw0iJSaMLuqLdpvgEhSz7QyjCfA9uAaCVjgbO5QRCvyt1RYXDsTSjYQnaa3q3gosrt3eiifeezbxhTuN-qxu7srJTFQ)
- **Hidden alcohol:** Check labels on cold medicines, cough syrups, and mouthwashes, as they can contain alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF16-r8k5YPf1XWKnKytcsWKCWB4TwcUL4BI913N68sCUIf7d6Pr6C43R7ntTIfx_-uhTGqkZ1oVNjpZCX2cgxSMkWx6TrmTx3wKKsvqKwetOqOoqZMm1kqyy-9rcrzDFSdzrTdMuTWhyWFEhbxoeKVy45lbjsN_MN36FWCwWIjemaXe_-qPnZNnEOAUfb7KbBBR-tjMrUn96VqdAemjSGEW-pyVHbcV4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXu9qylKg8L4mcf9vLYA_B62Fov9gLbJyoENDxYG7aAQD8kMj6J_N99u2jUEc8hE--mZ0E94Z7tYyvXi1U3TKVxZmeghzN2QNv-J4YEtanfUiJs8oai42UV7oWh28B8XsM1W6rdUyX4Yk71hy6nkEy)

Hidden alcohol: Check labels on cold medicines, cough syrups, and mouthwashes, as they can contain alcohol.
